name: N-gram頻度分析
description: 分析します word and character n-gram 分布s を検出するために パターン characteristic of AI生成の text.
useCase: Detecting AI text through 統計分析 of word sequence パターン
mechanism: 抽出します character-level and word-level n-gram frequency 分布s and compares them against known 分布s for human and AI生成の text. AI text generators produce characteristic n-gram パターン — often over-representing common phrases and under-representing rare but natural human constructions.
accuracy: 中-高 - 75-85% on diverse text samples
source: Lavergne et al. (2008) - Detecting Fake Content with Relative Entropy Scoring, PAN-SEPLN
algorithm: N-gram Extraction + Frequency Distribution Analysis + KL-Divergence Scoring
parameters: N-gram sizes: 2-5, Level: character + word, Comparison: KL-divergence, chi-square, Corpus: reference 分布s
strengths:
• Language-model agnostic approach
• Can analyze very short texts
• 計算効率が高い
• Captures subtle 分布 differences
limitations:
• Requires reference 分布s for calibration
• Domain-specific text may skew results
• Modern AI models converge toward natural 分布s
• Cross-domain generalization can be weak

references.title: Lavergne, T. et al. (2008). Detecting Fake Content with Relative Entropy Scoring. PAN-SEPLN.
Solaiman, I. et al. (2019). Release Strategies and the Social Impacts of Language Models. OpenAI Technical Report.
Beresneva, D. (2016). Computer-Generated Text Detection Using Machine Learning: A Systematic Review. NLDB.
